evidence_spans: Evaluations across five neural networks on ImageNet-1K demonstrate that under post-training quantization (PTQ), NAMSI achieves 54.2%–60.4% reductions in post-synthesis MAC ADP compared with FP32 while retaining at least 99% of full-precision Top-1 accuracy, surpassing baseline approaches in both hardware efficiency and accuracy preservation.
